entry.name: mc.dac~
entry.description: The mc.dac~ ("digital-to-analog converter") object sends its signal inputs to audio hardware. Double-click on an mc.dac~ to open the Audio Status window to configure audio settings and hardware.

arguments.name: outputs
arguments.description: Whenhas no arguments, it sends all channels of its connected multichannel input to audio output channels starting at logical channel 1.Whenhas channel number arguments, it sends channels of its connected multichannel input to the specified audio output channel(s). If there are more channels in the multichannel input than channel arguments, the additional channels of the input are ignored.If a symbol is provided as the first argument to aobject, its output will be sent to the Max mixer. Ifinstances in a patcher hierarchy share the same name they will use the same mixer output.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Double-click to open the Audio Status window
messages.description: Double-clicking onopens the Audio Status window.

messages.name: int
messages.description: A non-zero number turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of numbers sets the logical output channels for each channel in the multichannel input starting with the first input channel. For example, sendingtowill assign the first channel in an input multichannel signal to audio output channel 3, the second channel of the input to audio output channel 4, and the third channel of the input to audio output channel 5.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Assign the first audio output channel
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the logical output channels for the first channel in the input multichannel signal. For instance,assigns the first channel of the input to logical output channel 3. To assign multiple channels, use themessage.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Theobject sends the audio in its multichannel input to audio output channels. The Arguments section describes how audio channels in the multichannel input are assigned to audio outputs. The signal must be between -1 and 1 to avoid clipping.

messages.name: start
messages.digest: Turn on audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: startwindow
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: Turns on audio processing only in the patch in which thisis located, and in subpatches of that patch. Turns off audio processing in all other patches.

messages.name: stop
messages.digest: Disable audio processing in all loaded patches
messages.description: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: wclose
messages.description: Closes the Audio Status window if it is open.
